title: Dreamy Paititi
description: You encounter a nursery full of blooming Brewblossoms in the wilderness of Tete Isle. It appears to be administered by a mysterious woman...

mainQuestExcel.title: Dreamy Paititi
mainQuestExcel.description: You encounter a nursery full of blooming Brewblossoms in the wilderness of Tete Isle. It appears to be administered by a mysterious woman...

dialogs.text: Hmm... This bitter taste... Did I add too much Flamegrass?
Hey there.
Glowing Hornshrooms... They need to be fermented first, then steamed twice. Hmm... The effect is still too weak...
...Umm, is she just gonna keep ignoring us?
Flamegrass?
(A softly glowing flower bud sways at your touch, pulsing to some silent, secret rhythm...)
Hey! Hands off, please!
I'm sorry.
You're quite polite. No wonder it doesn't dislike you.
Hey! Look at the flower! Is it... dancing?
Looks more like... wriggling to me.
Eww! Don't use such disgusting language on a flower! At least say it's "swaying" or something!
That's the "Dance of Erzulie." The flowers only react this way when someone with a strong affinity for clairvoyance draws near.
That's because Brewblossoms draw in spiritual energy from the land and produce a special nectar that heightens one's sensitivity to dreams.

Some people... Hmm, how should I put it? They're born with a natural spiritual affinity. So Brewblossoms, which absorb spiritual essence, are naturally more drawn to them. After all, legend says they're plants that act as a bridge between worlds.
By the way, I'm "Mad-Eye" Atzilli, a winemaker at the Me & Dew. And who might you be?
#{M#I'm Svetlana Babushka, "Fist of the Beastly Ape."}{F#I'm Emmanuelle, the "Alloy Oakleg."}
And Paimon's the "Soaring Hero," Hunter Gordon! Ah...
Pffft... Did you mean to introduce yourself with both names?
Don't call Paimon out! It's not like your name's any less weird!
#Alright, enough joking! Paimon's Paimon, and this is {NICKNAME}!
#Paimon and {NICKNAME}, huh? You've got perfect timing! There's actually something I need your help with!
Eh? Anything to do with that... clairvoyance thing you talked about?
Ooh, sharp! Here, have a candy.
Yay! You're the best!
So here's the deal. I've been working on a brand-new drink for the Me & Dew. Mainly to help my clueless big sis pull in some fresh-faced, trend-chasing clientele.
And my latest project is... Well, it goes something like this...
"A dreamy, joy-sparking, zero-alcohol blend that lets ordinary folks feel a clairvoyance-adjacent sensation without getting tipsy or having to deal with a hangover!"
The key ingredient is a dollop of high-purity nectar from these Brewblossoms. But that's where the problem lies...
Is the nectar not pure enough?
Bingo! Another candy for you!
Hehe, Paimon's on a roll today!
If only my affinity for clairvoyance were strong enough, I could spot the flaws instantly... But as it stands, all I can do is test and analyze the samples over and over again.
But thankfully, you showed up, and it looks like your affinity's much stronger than mine! Hehe, you might just be the answer to my prayers!
Alright, what can I do to help?
First, drink this little bottle of nectar extract. Then I'll explain.
It's worth a shot.
Here. Take this.
You down the nectar in one gulp. A strange sweetness, tinged with some putrid pungency, spreads through your body...\nLike a dream long forgotten, unraveling into damp, glimmering mist....
The mist quickly clears, and your vision returns to normal.
See? Told you you'd be fine. Now let's get started!
There are three flower fields right outside. With your help, I'll be able to spot the tainted Brewblossoms in no time.
Follow me. I'll tell you about the tools we're going to use.
Uhh... This stuff looks kinda suspicious...
Relax! Theoretically, the worst it can do is blind you!
And hey, if your affinity for clairvoyance is really that great, you'll be fine, even with a bad eye. You've got two, right?
Well, "eye" protest your ridiculous sense of logic!
Pfft, chill, chill! I'm just joking! You won't go blind. Probably.
Can we just get started already?!
#Hello, I'm {NICKNAME}.
And Paimon's Paimon!
It touched me first.
Heh, a smooth talker, huh? But... Hmm... It doesn't seem to dislike you.
This one here is the "Dream Extractor," we can collect the purest pollen from the Brewblossoms.
First, we'll need to weed out the bad flowers. Those would be the ones tainted with impurities.
These plants have absorbed too much gunk from underground, and that messes with the effects and the safety of the drink.
But how can we tell which ones are bad?
They'll react to people with special constitutions. I'm not sure how they'll react exactly, but I know that if you get close enough, the flower's bound to do something weird and obvious.
You'll see what I mean once we're in the flower fields.

flow.stepDescription: Investigate the issue with the flower fields

dialogs.text: Let me see... Mm-hmm! The pollen in this Dream Extractor is super pure.
Perfect! Which means that last flower was definitely the contaminated one.
"Mad Eye" Atzilli carefully pours the freshly gathered nectar into a tiny vial. Then, with practiced flair, she adds a few drops from other vials filled with brightly colored liquids...
A few minutes later...
Hmm... Judging by the sample, the purity's spot-on. No sign of any impurities or sediment. Excellent!
Let's power through and finish up the last two flower fields!

flow.stepDescription: Investigate the issue with the flower fields

dialogs.text: Purrrr...
Meeeow?
Whoa! A kitty!
Atzilli, what a two-faced witch you are! Did you start raising humans behind my back?
Ugh... Humans... Rude, filthy, stinking humans!
Didn't your mothers teach you how to treat a poor, lonely, free-spirited delicate flower like me...? *sniff*
*sniff* Anyway, I'm "Dambara the Pale," but you can just call me Dambara.
Face the wrath of my claws, foolish intruders! My fangs thirst for justice!
H—Hey! Why aren't you scared?! Am I not scary enough...? Tch...
Easy, kitty. No need to go full beast-mode.
Ha! What's your game? Planning to hurt me? Steal my precious pollen?
...Meeeow! You scoundrel!
Begone, foul mirage!
You swing your sword at Dambara the Pale, and — Poof! The little cat vanishes...
I'm not here to hurt you. I'm just... ignoring you.
Meow! I knew it you were out for my— Wait, what?
You didn't take any pollen? Or drink any nectar?
Nope. You've got too many weird impurities in your body.
Eh? Uhh... Hmm.
I... I see. Then I must've misunderstood. Sorry about that. If you're not going to hurt me, I won't hurt you either.
Well then... Goodbye.
Please stop. I'm so scared I'm about to cry.
You're just an illusion, aren't you? Guess I'll just have to get rid of you.
You swing your sword at Dambara the Pale, and — poof! The little cat vanishes...
You can't fool me with an illusion. Taste my blade!
Meeeow!!!
You swing your sword at the illusion, and — poof! The little cat vanishes...
Hroooo... Woof! Woof, woof!
I am Sir Woofington Briannus, knight of this realm! Pray tell, what names do you bear?
#Just call me {NICKNAME}.
#Awoo~ Well met, {M#Sir}{F#Lady} {NICKNAME}! What brings you hither?
I'm looking for the flowers you're guarding.
As I feared. Alas, I have sworn on my blade to forbid outsiders from approaching my squire and maiden.
Squire and maiden... So there are two flowers?
Err, well... biologically speaking, each Brewblossom has both a stamen and a pistil, yes?
So... Technically, a single flower is both squire and maiden at the same time.
Trying to distract me with biology? Not happening — En garde!
You swing your sword at Sir Briannus, and — poof! The big dog vanishes...
That's... oddly progressive.
Woof! Did you just call flowers "progressive"? I'll have you know they predate the very concept!
#Well then, {M#Sir}{F#Lady} {NICKNAME}, it has been a pleasure. But my sworn duty calls — have at thee!
Sir Briannus challenges you to a duel. You swing your sword at the big dog, and — Poof! It vanishes...
Good doggie, good doggie.
Wroo, rrooh! Woof, woof!
Who's the goodest pet around?
Woof, woof!
It's Paimon, of course!
Huh!?
You dare mock a knight to his face? I demand a duel!
Sir Briannus challenges you to a duel. You swing your sword at the big dog, and — Poof! It vanishes...
Oink oink... Mmm... Oink oink...
Let me guess — you can talk?
Oink oink?
Oink... oink...
Oh? And why do you think that?
Oink oink... oink oink! Mmm, mmh... oink oink!
I see... Do you have any family?
Oink oink...
Ahem! Not to interrupt this... beautiful friendship, but...
Paimon's pretty sure the flower we're looking for is over there!
Huh? What?
Oink oink! Oink oink!
This isn't another illusion!?
I also have one person I consider family.
Oink oink! Mmmph, mmph...!
That's a sound argument. I concur!
Oink oink! Oink oink!
#Hello, I'm {NICKNAME}.
Oink oink!
You're an illusion, aren't you? Take this!
Oink oink?!
You swing your sword at the forest boar — It gives a loud squeal and then collapses...
Atzilli, we're back!
#There were three bad flowers in that field! But, umm... {NICKNAME} was acting a little strange. You're okay, right...?
Yeah, I'm fine.
Hallucinations? Then there's no need to worry. It's common for Brewblossoms to release hallucinogenic pollen as a defense mechanism. They must've been especially reactive to you.
Paimon and I couldn't see what you were seeing because the pollen doesn't affect us the same way.
#But still... hmm. {NICKNAME}, are you experiencing any other symptoms?
Nope. Not yet, anyway...
All right. You know yourself best, but if anything starts to feel off, please let me know immediately.
Then let's finish up the last field in one go!
Just pollen-induced hallucinations. No big deal.

flow.stepDescription: Investigate the issue with the flower fields

dialogs.text: "Farewell, child of the stars! Should we not meet again in this nation... I shall await you in another..."\n
"Tarry not, oh tarry not..."
A dizzying wave rises with the thick, sticky sweetness of the flowers...\nBy the time your senses return, Paimon is already hovering nervously around you.
#{NICKNAME}, hey! Wake up! Are you alright? We found the flower!
You totally spaced out for a second there... Were you seeing stuff again?
Let's use the Dream Extractor first. I'm fine.
Well, as long as you're okay!
Atzilli! We found the weird flower you mentioned!
#But... something's off with {NICKNAME}. Any ideas?
I'm fine, just a little lightheaded.
Did you see anything over there? Some kind of dangerous hallucination?
You describe the hallucination you saw to Atzilli...
The "Papa Witch Doctor's Prank"...
What's that?
It's an old tale passed down among shamans and brewers. They say Papa Witch Doctor guides the spirits of those who were unlucky and didn't die in glorious battle.
He's the kind of twisted spirit who treats fear like a game — always crafting eerie nightmares to toy with the living who catch his eye.
#Anyway... Ahem! Anyway, let me look you over, {NICKNAME}. You should be mostly fine.
#Hmm... Alright, no need to worry. Seems like {NICKNAME} just inhaled too much of the hallucinogenic pollen. You might feel dizzy for a bit, but it's nothing serious.
I see...
But if any long lasting effects cause brain damage and drop your intelligence... Well, I'm afraid I can't help you with that!
Hey!
Haha, just kidding! Now let me finish up the last step here.
"Mad Eye" Atzilli carefully pours the freshly gathered nectar into a tiny vial. Then, with practiced flair, she adds a few drops from other vials filled with brightly colored liquids...
A few minutes later...
Let's see... Purities... Impure sediments... Toxicity levels... all within acceptable levels! Whoo! We're finally done!
Thanks so much for your help. Here's your reward!
Yay! Thanks!
Ah, wait a moment! We're not done yet!
I'm about to start mixing my special "Sweet Dream Brew," and I'd love for you to come by and help me out with your clairvoyance again.
Looks like we might have results by tomorrow, so see you then! Who knows, maybe I'll even name the new drink after you!
I'll also answer those questions you had earlier, so don't forget to come over!

flow.stepDescription: Talk to Atzilli and try out the "dream drink"

dialogs.text: Haha, remember that "Sweet Dream Brew" I mentioned? Well, I've got some great news for you!
After a full day of work, I've finally perfected the recipe!
Congratulations!
Hehe, and you lucky two get to be my first customers! Don't worry about paying, I'll put it on my sister's tab!
Yippee! Free drinks!
Wait, hold on... You're just telling us we're your test subjects...
Of course! Aren't you honored?
Not at all!
I need to be sure this drink isn't dangerous.
Hmm? Oh, right... I did, didn't I...?
First off, I have to warn you — Brewblossom extract is highly toxic. But after repeated distillations, I've reduced the toxicity to a level that is tolerable for normal people.
By "tolerable," I mean to say that a normal person will "die" within about... Hmm, five seconds.
And when they "die," their soul will wander through a place where the mortal realm and the land of the dead overlap... I guess that's a good enough explanation.
Which part of "die within five seconds" sounds "tolerable" to you!?
So you're saying drinking it will kill me.
It's not a true death, per se, because your body will continue to function normally. Unless... you get so lost in the dreamscape that you forget to come back.
Then my sister and I would have to deal with a still-breathing corpse.
Hey! So this isn't safe to drink at all, is it!?
Haha, don't you worry! Before y'all got here, I tested it out on myself.
Rest assured, I added Glowing Hornshrooms and the spiciest Brilliant Chrysanthemums I could get my hands on!
The Glowing Hornshroom lights the way for the soul back to the body, and the Brilliant Chrysanthemum's wicked kick snaps your senses awake, pulling you right back into, well, you.
So when you drink it, you won't even notice you've "died" once.
I'm not exaggerating. Trust me!
So? Wanna try? Or are you chicken?
I'm not scared of something like that.
#Then... give Paimon one too! No way {NICKNAME}'s going anywhere without her!
Haha, no worries — there's plenty for both of you! Here are your two cups of "Sweet Dream Brew."
After a moment's hesitation, you drink the strange brew.\nThe flavor is wondrous yet bizarre, laced with latent spice and a faintly putrid tang...
And then, a hazy dream...
That's nothing. I've "died" more times than I can count.
Hmph... give Paimon one too! She's not going to let you show off on your own!
It's fine, Paimon! The worst that can happen is that... I... die?
You promised to explain the secret behind it.
Wah! Mi zido mita dada! Mmm~ Yaya dada! Movo dada!
Olah! Mosi mita yo! Sada mimi dada! Sada domu dada!
Yo ya dala?
I'm your friend, and you're my friend! We're all good friends!
Ahaha! Mi zido mita dada!
Sado! Yo beru mimi beru!?
Haha, what are you talking about? You're the one who started speaking our language!
Sama! Mito! Ya upa dala?
Ya upa dala?
Hehe, there's treasure up there! Let's go dig it up!
The treasure's right here! Let's share it!
Mimi Mani! Mimi mosi! Mimi muhe!
Mimi muhe!
Yay! Treasure!
Mosi mita! Mita dada! Hahahahahaha!
Unta dada, yoyo upa, nunu beru valo yoyo...
Mi in dala?
Oh, you're in a happy place — a very happy place!
So? How's my "Sweet Dream Brew"? Tasty?
#Ugh... Paimon's head hurts so bad... {NICKNAME}, are you okay?
We had a very strange dream...
We dreamed we were digging treasure... with Hilichurls?
Umm... It's hard to explain... By the way, were we "dead" for a long time?
Yup, and I've been dead for a long time too.
Eh?
Hahahaha! Just kidding! You were only out for a few seconds... I was worried it wouldn't work at all!
Good thing it did! Now, please tell me everything you saw in your dream — I'll write it all down!
Huh? Uh... We'll try!
You and Paimon piece together the bizarre dreamscape as "Mad-Eye" Atzilli listens intently, scribbling down notes.
Haha, that was great! It was total nonsense, but overall, what a fun dream it must have been!
But why hilichurls? That's strange...
Well, leave that mystery to me and my sister. Here's your reward!
Um... So you're really planning to sell this strange drink?
Oh, we're still a long way off from actually selling it. I still need to test it on more people with different constitutions.
Once you leave this place, you probably won't see our brew on shelves for quite a while.
Phew... That's a bit of a relief. Its effects are... kinda strong.
Strong and strange.
Pfft... Alright, alright, I get it!
Now that the experiment's over, you're free to go!
If you feel sick or experience any more side effects, do come find me.
Will do!
